title: BetterSpawnerss
description: Smart spawner solution for your server!
body:
**BetterSpawners** is a lightweight spawner overhaul with tiered drops, stacking, and in‑game GUIs. Create custom spawner templates, upgrade tiers, and fine‑tune spawning behavior with performance‑friendly settings. Optional Vault and DecentHolograms support.
Spigot/Paper 1.18+

Use "/betterspawners" or "/bs" command to look up commands

1. **Core**
​
- Custom spawner templates with tiered drops and prices
- Default mob drops or custom drops per tier
- Persistent storage in spawners.yml (upgrade state saved)
- Configurable spawn delay, count (random roll), range, max‑nearby
- Stack‑scaled spawn output and nearby limits

2. **GUI & Management**
​
- In‑game spawner creator GUI
- Library GUI to edit and reuse templates
- Tier upgrade GUI (unlock/select per spawner)

3. **Stacking & Placement**
​
- Spawner stacking with configurable limits
- One spawner type per chunk (mob + drop)
- Mob stacking with configurable limits


Plugin uses vault as economy dependency

https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/
